meta.name: security-triage
meta.description: Triage GitHub security advisories for CrawClaw with high-confidence close/keep decisions, exact tag and commit verification, trust-model checks, optional hardening notes, and a final reply ready to post and copy to clipboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分诊 GitHub 安全公告，快速决策关闭或保留
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效筛选和决策大量 GitHub 安全公告
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to efficiently filter and decide on many GitHub security advisories

howto.what: 专门审查CrawClaw仓库的安全公告（GHSA），决定关闭或保留，验证代码版本和信任范围，最后生成可发布的回复并复制到剪贴板。
howto.when: 当用户要求审核CrawClaw的安全公告、草稿或GHSA报告时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个CrawClaw安全公告，判断是否关闭。
say.note: Claude会检查条件并给出决定。

say.text: 分析这个GHSA报告，给出关闭或保留的建议。
say.note: 会验证代码版本和信任模型。

say.text: 对CrawClaw安全公告进行分流，生成回复草稿。
say.note: 最终回复会复制到剪贴板。

howto.what_en: Reviews CrawClaw GitHub security advisories (GHSA), decides close or keep, verifies tags/commits and trust model, then drafts a maintainer-ready reply and copies it to clipboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to review a CrawClaw security advisory, draft, or GHSA report.

say_en.text: Triage this CrawClaw security advisory and decide whether to close.
say_en.note: Claude checks close conditions and gives a determination.

say_en.text: Analyze this GHSA report and recommend close or keep.
say_en.note: Verifies code version and trust model.

say_en.text: Triage a CrawClaw security advisory and generate a reply draft.
say_en.note: Final reply will be copied to clipboard.
